city_route_pairs.route_label: Hurghada Marina → Giftun Island (Orange Bay / Mahmya)
city_route_pairs.city_thesis: Giftun Island is Hurghada's flagship excursion — white-sand islands and the Orange Bay and Mahmya reefs, reached by boat and drawing roughly 187,000 visitors a year.
Ras Mohammed's reefs rank among the Red Sea's finest dive and snorkel sites, reached by boat from Sharm and drawing about 50,000 visitors a year.
